risk_levels.R1: Local, reversible workspace changes with verification.
risk_levels.R2: Dependencies, migrations, infrastructure drafts, or broad refactors.
risk_levels.R3: External side effects: deploy, publish, send, spend, create paid resources.
risk_levels.R4: Irreversible or destructive operations, production data, credentials, legal commitments.

autonomous.description: Continue through all in-scope reversible work without pausing.

hitl.description: Human approves product intent, architecture, readiness, and release.

supervised.description: Autonomous execution with human checkpoints only for deviations and external actions.

absolute_human_gates: public publishing or messaging real people
spending money or creating paid resources
handling real credentials or payment methods
installing software with broad system access or modifying system settings
